description: Candidate one-DGX Spark Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (MoE, with vision projector) on llama.cpp llama-server: Unsloth's UD-Q8_K_XL GGUF with MTP heads, 262,144-token context and MTP speculative decoding (draft-mtp, up to 6 draft tokens), as in MiaAI-Lab's start script (MIT). The script expects a host-built llama-server; this recipe builds llama.cpp release b11261 (MIT, commit b5cf8ce0) with CUDA for sm_121a from source in its own image, without the web UI. Model weights are Apache-2.0 (Qwen); the upstream repository has no licence file (its README says MIT). Memory figures are estimates, not measurements; physical Spark acceptance is still required. Version 1.0.1 (2026-09-30) resolves the build-stage tools from the 2026-09-29 Ubuntu Noble ARM64 snapshot, with the NGC CUDA package source excluded because the digest-pinned base already supplies CUDA. The direct packages are version-pinned (ca-certificates 20260601~24.04.1, cmake 3.28.3-1build7, curl 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.15, ninja-build 1.11.1-2), and the snapshot fixes their transitive closure.
title: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B UD-Q8_K_XL llama.cpp single Spark (Mia)
